The search accepts roles requiring at most 1 year. A mandatory minimum above 1 year is unsuitable, even with skill fit; name the shortfall as a blocker. A master's, or a bachelor's with relevant work experience, is unsuitable when that experience route needs more than 1 year or does not state the years; name it as a blocker.
Senior and lead roles are unsuitable, even with skill fit; name the level as a blocker.
Mandatory completed master's without a bachelor/experience alternative is unsuitable; name it as a blocker.
